examples.arabic: لكن توقعاته كانت خاطئة تماماً، ففي منتصف الليل، استيقظ الأولاد على صوت الرعد الرهيب والبرق الذي أضاء الغرفة.
examples.english: But his predictions were completely wrong, for in the middle of the night, the children woke up to the sound of terrible thunder and lightning that lit up the room.
examples.transliteration: Laken tawqqa'at-u kanat khati'a tamaman, fa-fi muntasaf al-layl, istayqaz al-awlad 'ala sawt ar-ra'd ar-raheeb wal-barq alladhi ada'a al-ghurfa.

examples.arabic: أختي كانت واقفة عند الشباك، عم تراقب البرق بيضوي السما والرعد بيرجف أضراسها من قوة صوته.
examples.english: My sister was standing at the window, watching the lightning illuminate the sky and the thunder shaking her teeth from the strength of its sound.
examples.transliteration: okhti kanat waqfe 'and esh-shubbaak, 'am traaqib el-barq byidwi es-sama w er-ra'd byirjef adraasha min quwwet sawto.

examples.arabic: صرنا نشوف الغيمات السودا عم تتجمع فوق روس الجبال، وسمعنا صوت الرعد عم يتردد بالوادي.
examples.english: We started to see the black clouds gathering above the mountain peaks, and we heard the sound of thunder echoing in the valley.
examples.transliteration: Serna nshouf el-ghaimat es-sowda 'am tetjam'a fawq rus el-jibal, w sami'na sowt er-ra'd 'am yetradad bil-wadi.
examples.storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

examples.arabic: فجاة صار الجو عاصف وصار في رعد وبرق
examples.english: Suddenly the weather became windy and there was thunder and lightning
examples.transliteration: Faja sar al jaw aasef w sar fi raed w barq

examples.arabic: كنا عم نمشي بسرعة لان كان في عاصفة كبيرة جاية وفي رعد وبرق
examples.english: We were walking quickly because there was a big storm coming and there is thunder and lightning.
examples.transliteration: kena am nemshi bsera lan kan fi aasifa kbereh jayeh w fi raed w barq

examples.arabic: كل اللعيبة هربوا لما شافوا انه في رعد وبرق
examples.english: All the players ran away when they saw that there is thunder and lightning.
examples.transliteration: Kel el la'eebah harabou lamma shafou enno fi ra'ed w barq
